2124948748380082685.en_summary: TradexWhisperer on $MU $SKHY: 3D DRAM will be a necessity for AGI and super intelligent agents because of extreme bandwidth needed between GPU and memory. CEO Sanjay Mehrotra: All major customers seeking to collaborate on stacked 3D DRAM. Broader adoption expected in 2030–2031. Initial market traction expected in 2028–2029. Despite thermal challenges, 3D DRAM could become key growth engine toward end of decade. CTO Scott DeBoer: Literally every big customer asking for partnership to co-design base die, stack memory, put on accelerator chip. Moves AI to next level. Multi-layer stacks on processors start 2028–2029, big proliferation by 2030–2031. Thermal major hurdle as DRAM temperature-sensitive on high-power GPUs. Requires close co-innovation. Helps Micron move beyond commodity pricing to strategic role in AI system design. Related: 75% of Micron’s 2027 supply already sold out, discussions into 2028. 26 Strategic Customer Agreements backed by $32B upfront cash and commitments. Many SCAs 5+ years with take-or-pay, deposits, pricing bands.
2124948748380082685.zh_summary: TradexWhisperer 關於 $MU $SKHY：3D DRAM 將成為 AGI 和超智能代理的必需品，因為 GPU 與記憶體之間需要極高帶寬。CEO Sanjay Mehrotra：所有主要客戶尋求在堆疊 3D DRAM 上合作。預計 2030–2031 年更廣泛採用。初始市場牽引力預計 2028–2029 年。儘管熱挑戰，3D DRAM 可能成為十年末的關鍵增長引擎。CTO Scott DeBoer：幾乎每個大客戶都要求合作共同設計基底晶片、堆疊記憶體並放在加速器晶片上。將 AI 提升到下一層級。處理器上的多層堆疊可能 2028–2029 年開始進入市場，到 2030–2031 年大量擴散。熱是主要障礙，因為 DRAM 對溫度敏感且直接位於高功率 GPU 上。需要與客戶緊密共同創新。幫助 Micron 超越商品定價，成為 AI 系統設計中的戰略角色。相關：Micron 2027 年供應 75% 已售罄，討論進入 2028。26 個戰略客戶協議由 320 億美元預付現金和承諾支持。許多 SCA 5 年以上，帶有 take-or-pay 條款、存款和定價帶。
